data.name: Rakeeb
data.gender_notes: Rakeeb is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who guards or protects. Derived from the Arabic word ‘raqaaba’ meaning to protect or guard. The name Rakeeb carries the meaning “Protector, Defender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rakeeb usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, defender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Rakeeb belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Defender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rakeeb total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: رقيب
in_arabic.meaning: حفظ کرنے والا، نگہبان، مراقبہ کرنے والا
in_arabic.long_meaning: رقيب (raqīb) کا مطلب ہے کوئی ایسا شخص جو کسی چیز کی حفاظت کرتا ہے یا نگہداشت کرتا ہے، خاص طور پر ایسا شخص جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی عبادت میں لگا رہتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربى جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جہاں 'ر-ق-ب' کا مطلب 'حفظ کرنا' یا 'نگہداشت کرنا' ہوتا ہے۔ قرآن میں یہ لفظ مراقبہ اور حفاظت کے معنی میں استعمال ہوا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: رقیب
in_urdu.meaning: حفظ کرنے والا، نگہبان، مراقبہ کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: رقیب نام کا مطلب ہے ایک ایسا شخص جو حفاظت کرتا ہے یا نگہداشت کرتا ہے، خاص طور پر وہ شخص جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی عبادت میں مشغول رہتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے نکلا ہے، جہاں 'ر-ق-ب' کا مطلب 'حفظ کرنا' یا 'نگہداشت کرنا' ہوتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، یہ نام روحانی محافظ اور مراقبہ کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रकीब
in_hindi.long_meaning: रकीब नाम का अर्थ है एक व्यक्ति जो कुछ की रक्षा करता है या उसकी देखभाल करता है, विशेष रूप से वह व्यक्ति जो अल्लाह की इबादत में लगा रहता है। यह नाम अरबी जड़ों से निकला है, जहां 'र-क-ब' का अर्थ है 'रक्षा करना' या 'देखभाल करना'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक संरक्षक और ध्यान के महत्व को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: رقيب
in_pashto.long_meaning: رقيب نوم د داسې چا معنی لري چې څه شی پاملرنه کوي یا ساتي، په ځانګړي ډول هغه څوک چې د الله تعالی عبادت کوي. دا نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چیرته چې 'ر-ق-ب' د 'ساتن' یا 'پاملرنې' معنی لري. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو مسلمینو لپاره، دا نوم د روحاني ساتونکي او مراقبې اهميت ښيي.

in_english.name: Rakeeb
in_english.meaning: one who preserves, protects, or observes
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rakeeb originates from Arabic roots 'r-q-b', meaning 'to preserve', 'to protect', or 'to observe'. It refers to someone who takes care of or watches over something or someone. In Islamic context, it signifies a person devoted to spiritual observation or preservation. The name holds historical significance in Islamic tradition, reflecting virtues of care and vigilance. Across Muslim cultures, Rakeeb conveys a sense of responsibility and spiritual dedication.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rakeeb reflects the strong defenders and protectors in Islamic and Middle Eastern cultures. Named children may be encouraged to live up to this legacy and protect their families, communities, or nations. Rakeeb can also be used as a reminder of the Islamic principle of protecting the weak and vulnerable.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rakeeb is a constant reminder to protect one's own spiritual growth and guard against moral corruption. It encourages the pursuit of knowledge to strengthen faith, and to provide guidance for those who may be lost or in need. In essence, Rakeeb serves as an inspiration to become a guardian of one's own soul as well as a defender for others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Protector, Defender" symbolizes One who guards or protects. Derived from the Arabic word ‘raqaaba’ meaning to protect or guard.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rakeeb serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of protector, defender.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Hisham, Al-Sirah Al-Nabawiyyah, 1/219 The name Rakeeb carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Rakeeb is the name of a man from the tribe of Banu Asad who was one of the early converts to Islam. He was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is mentioned in various hadiths.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Rakeeb remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Fatima Rakeeb, a teacher in Dubai, UAE, shares that their name Rakeeb meaning "Protector, Defender" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
